title: ui-prompt: create main textarea
description: Create the main prompt textarea component that serves as the primary input for users to describe their planning tasks. This component handles text input, validation, and synchronization with application state.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL support multiline text input in the textarea
THE SYSTEM SHALL display a placeholder when the textarea is empty
THE SYSTEM SHALL auto-resize the textarea based on content up to a maximum height

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user types in the textarea
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL update application state with the current text value
THE SYSTEM SHALL display a visual focus indicator

unwanted.condition: IF the text exceeds the maximum character limit
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT accept additional characters
unwanted.because: exceeding limits could cause backend validation failures

unwanted.condition: IF the component is in read-only mode
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow text modifications
unwanted.because: read-only mode must preserve data integrity

preconditions: The component must receive an initial value or empty string
The parent must provide an onChange callback handler
postconditions: After user input, the state reflects the current textarea value
After losing focus, the value is trimmed of leading/trailing whitespace
invariants: The textarea value always equals the bound state value
Character count is always accurate and displayed

happy: Type text and verify state updates correctly
Paste multiline content and verify proper formatting
error: Exceed character limit and verify input is blocked
Submit empty textarea and verify validation error displays

phase_0: Review existing textarea patterns in Dioxus
phase_2: Create PromptTextarea component with value, on_change, placeholder props
Implement auto-resize using CSS or JS interop

similar: See Textarea component in ui/ for textarea patterns
